summary.text: A grand tribulation sits above heavenly tribulations on the calamity ladder. Gu Immortals at rank seven face one every hundred years; those at rank eight face one every fifty.

claims.text: Gu Immortals at rank seven face an earthly calamity every ten years, a heavenly tribulation every fifty years, and a grand tribulation every one hundred years. Cultivation talk marks Gu Immortals by how many grand tribulations they have passed, such as one grand tribulation or two grand tribulations cultivation level. Gu Immortals at rank eight no longer experience earthly calamities, but they face a heavenly tribulation every ten years, a grand tribulation every fifty years, and a myriad tribulation every one hundred years.

Earthly calamities, heavenly tribulations, grand tribulations, and myriad tribulations are ranked by increasing strength. Relic vajra tribulation is named as stronger than a heavenly tribulation and therefore a grand tribulation. Catastrophes such as snow war tribulation lightning still sit within heavenly tribulation limits. Grand tribulations are more terrifying than heavenly tribulations and earthly calamities. Countless Gu Immortals have died to them, so experts work under constant pressure to prepare. For rank eight Gu Immortals, a challenge that threatens them every fifty years is the grand tribulation.

On average, an ordinary grand tribulation gives about seven thousand dao marks, while an ordinary myriad tribulation gives about eighty thousand. The new dao marks from a grand tribulation include the Gu Immortal’s main path as well as some marks of other paths.

After becoming rank nine, calamities and tribulations become even more terrifying. Venerables face a grand tribulation every ten years, a myriad tribulation every fifty years, and a chaotic disaster every one hundred years.
The hundred-year chaos trial is on chaotic disaster.
